newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier to launch neighborhood vehicle.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier to launch neighborhood vehicle.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Tuesday that it would proceed with the production and marketing of its Neighborhood Electric Vehicle (NEV).
Unveiled to the media last July, the Bombardier NEV is a two-seat electric vehicle designed for short-distance residential travel.
Bombardier said the NEV was developed mostly for sale in the southern United States. It said marketing of the NEV would begin in Arizona, California and Florida.
The NEV is manufactured in Sherbrooke, Quebec.
Equipped with lead batteries that can be recharged using a standard household 110-volt outlet, Bombardier's NEV has a range of about 50 kilometres and a maximum speed of 40 km/h.
Standard equipment includes four-wheel independent suspension, seat belts and a lockable rear trunk. The suggested U.S. retail price is US$6,699 (C$9,350).
